python3 -c "
import openpyxl
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook('book.xlsx')
ws=wb['Sales']
for ccf in ws.conditional_formatting: print(ccf.sqref)
h={r:ws.row_dimensions[r].height for r in range(1,23)}
ws.delete_rows(15);ws.delete_rows(8)
for r in range(2,20):
  ws[f'E{r}']=f'=C{r}*D{r}'; ws[f'F{r}']=f'=E{r}*CommissionRate'
for c in 'CEF': ws[f'{c}20']=f'=SUM({c}2:{c}19)'
for r in range(1,21): ws.row_dimensions[r].height=h[r if r<8 else r+1 if r<14 else r+2]
ws.row_dimensions[21].height=None;ws.row_dimensions[22].height=None
s=wb['Summary']
s['B3']='=Sales!E20';s['B4']='=Sales!F20'
s['B6']='=SUMIF(Sales!A2:A19,\"North\",Sales!E2:E19)'
wb.defined_names['SalesRevenue'].attr_text='Sales!\$E\$2:\$E\$19'
wb.save('book.xlsx')
for r in ws.iter_rows(min_row=7,max_row=20,values_only=True):print(r)
"
